name: Reconciliation: file content matches silver column-for-column
description: Every typed silver column is re-derived from the bronze worker_json and compared: zero field mismatches, identical worker sets, no promoted fields leaking into attributes, lineage intact.

assertions.name: zero_drift
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM myapp.raw_events b LEFT JOIN myapp.workers_current s ON s.worker_id = (b.worker_json ->> 'Worker_ID') WHERE b.file_id = {file_id}::uuid AND s.worker_id IS NULL
